title: The Lord Guides Our Path
verse: He prayed, “O Lord, God of my master Abraham, guide me today. Be faithful to my master Abraham.
observation: The servant of Abraham knew that he needed God’s help to accomplish his mission. Instead of trying to do it alone, he asked for the Lord’s help and the Lord guided his steps. We have to remember that the servant did not pray for help and then did nothing else. He did all he could do, but trusted the Lord to go with him and guide his steps. This is a helpful lesson for us all. We should always ask the Lord for guidance, but that does not mean we should sit and think He will bring the result to us. We apply ourselves and do all we can. Then, we trust the Lord to guide our steps, open the right doors, and do all the things we cannot do ourselves.
application: Where do you need to pray for guidance and then take the next right step?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always guiding us along the way.
